items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Dufresha had it as a gambling place when it first started. Called it B-25. Yeah. And the fellow named Paul Dufresha had it.

ctx.x: Seems like I heard it one time, they had music there too.

Well, it was a nightclub at one time. Oh, it really was. Yeah, it was a nightclub at one time. Dufresha had it as a gambling place when it first started. Called it B-25. Yeah. And the fellow named Paul Dufresha had it. It was a gambling place. And the Lord got closing up these gambling houses. And he made a nightclub out of it.
